lxc_6f05a3087f9dc594.text: Demon Slayer (Kimetsu no Yaiba) follows Tanjiro Kamado after a demon kills his family and turns his sister Nezuko into a demon.

lxc_a4cbc910a035d276.text: This explainer tells the main plot in six short parts.

lxc_cdeee87a1eba6560.text: Demon Slayer is a Japanese manga.

lxc_6ad81190f7ec278a.text: Its Japanese title is Kimetsu no Yaiba.

lxc_bb07792f3feb5433.text: The artist and writer is Koyoharu Gotouge.

lxc_337a2805a003cc07.text: The manga ran in the magazine Weekly Shōnen Jump from February 2016 to May 2020, and the full story fills 23 volumes.

lxc_0dc16d09c4dca30c.text: In 2019, the studio Ufotable made an anime, and the anime made the story famous all over the world.

lxc_c6cb999689813345.text: The story happens in Japan in the Taisho era.

lxc_5578eee89a9328a0.text: That is the time from 1912 to 1926, when Japan had trains and electric lights in cities, but many villages in the mountains still lived in the old way.

lxc_c69776a3ff4d30c2.text: In this world, demons hide in the dark and eat people.

lxc_5f69ee9209ba91e1.text: A small group of sword fighters, the Demon Slayer Corps, hunts them at night.

lxc_615463d3dff1e61c.text: The story follows one boy who joins this group.

lxc_596ca4c71d67036c.text: Tanjiro Kamado is the main character.

lxc_3e00d1a2be3b387e.text: He is a kind, hard-working boy who lives in the mountains with his mother, brothers, and sisters.

lxc_b746286f6570de30.text: His father is dead, so Tanjiro sells charcoal in the town below to feed the family.

lxc_1d601c54c6522924.text: He has a very strong nose, and he can smell feelings and danger.

lxc_50a5ebb4e9bf3abf.text: One day he goes to town and stays the night there because of the snow.

lxc_8ac974b559574964.text: When he comes home the next morning, a demon has killed his whole family.

lxc_c8bcffc099512da0.text: Only his younger sister, Nezuko Kamado, is alive, and the demon's blood has turned her into a demon too.

lxc_7b29afd6c3d1d0ce.text: Most demons attack humans right away, but Nezuko does not.

lxc_5e057e153b098df6.text: She still loves her brother and protects him.

lxc_093a76ffd5589f6b.text: Tanjiro now has one clear goal for the whole story.

lxc_285834a07b2415c1.text: He wants to find a cure and make Nezuko human again.

lxc_26180a0e546e7cad.text: On the same morning, a sword fighter named Giyu Tomioka finds Tanjiro and Nezuko.

lxc_b7d2cd6a411ee66e.text: He is a member of the Demon Slayer Corps, and his job is to kill demons.

lxc_08e51d90ec787482.text: He sees that Nezuko protects her brother instead of eating him, so he lets her live.

lxc_3f6b1dc239595772.text: He sends Tanjiro to an old teacher, Sakonji Urokodaki, who lives on a mountain.

lxc_26154fb1209dcbf5.text: Tanjiro trains there for two years.

lxc_b354412e2bb93752.text: He runs down the mountain at night, jumps over traps, and cuts a huge rock with his sword.

lxc_60e4dc6d03c47580.text: This is a way of breathing and moving that makes a sword fighter strong and fast, and each move looks like flowing water.

lxc_d7d318aa251f872f.text: In the end, he passes the Final Selection, a seven-day test on a mountain full of demons.

lxc_073c40642e133fb7.text: He becomes a Demon Slayer, and Nezuko travels with him in a wooden box on his back, because sunlight can kill a demon.

lxc_7682fad2056798c5.text: Tanjiro does not fight alone for long.

lxc_5fda254c28de8ec1.text: On his first missions, he meets two other young Demon Slayers, and they become his team.

lxc_60f1a0a2f7cde936.text: Zenitsu Agatsuma is a boy with yellow hair who is often afraid and cries a lot.

lxc_4b31e3fed02fb176.text: But he has very good ears, and when he sleeps, his body fights with Thunder Breathing, a fast style like lightning.

lxc_c611046b5fb8a193.text: He also likes Nezuko very much.

lxc_fafdf702f139070e.text: Wild boars raised him in the mountains, so he wears a boar head as a mask and shouts all the time.

lxc_7f8fe5a9a6807f6d.text: He fights with two swords and calls his style Beast Breathing.

lxc_0ee15d2eda00e030.text: He loves to fight and wants to be the strongest.

lxc_07ef22ee9e05dcd6.text: The three boys are noisy and often argue, but they help each other in every hard battle.

lxc_3794a3cc8255387c.text: They work together, and teamwork becomes a big theme of the story.

lxc_7c10193a877d330f.text: Every demon in the story comes from one person.

lxc_f57cc5d687dbfaf1.text: Muzan Kibutsuji is the first demon, and he is more than one thousand years old.

lxc_896ea474a6908fc6.text: Long ago, a doctor tried to cure his illness, and the medicine changed him into a demon.

lxc_26c3ca6ece069d46.text: Now his blood can turn humans into demons too.

lxc_3fd88a10cfa8ed26.text: Muzan killed Tanjiro's family, so he is also Tanjiro's personal enemy.

lxc_a78afde8ff144489.text: Demons are strong, they heal fast, and they eat humans to grow stronger.

lxc_91139cb3d776f228.text: But they cannot go into sunlight, and a special sword to the neck can kill them.

lxc_55bb1f14e1631e19.text: His dream is to become a perfect being who can walk in the day.

lxc_55509e341be9d2dd.text: He hides in cities, sometimes looking like a rich man with a family, and he sends his twelve strongest demons to fight for him.

lxc_edfb4378fac6384f.text: The Demon Slayer Corps has hunted him for a very long time.

lxc_470ff4a0d3ddb9e4.text: Tanjiro also meets Tamayo, a demon doctor who does not eat humans, and she agrees to help him look for Nezuko's cure.

lxc_94ccf735f86520c7.text: He and his friends fight many strong demons on their missions.

lxc_3a39dad037832a72.text: Each fight teaches Tanjiro something new about breathing, swords, and people.

lxc_0880bf987e34519f.text: Above the normal Demon Slayers stand the Hashira.

lxc_61093d74961395ac.text: The Hashira are the strongest sword fighters in the Demon Slayer Corps, and each one has a special breathing style.

lxc_5062a9d17c5bfee0.text: Tanjiro meets several of them as the story goes on, and he learns how hard their job is.

lxc_07b649f8f65d74eb.text: Through every battle, Tanjiro keeps two goals.

lxc_d446b65f82ae140e.text: He wants to make Nezuko human again, and he wants to stop Muzan Kibutsuji so demons stop hurting families.

lxc_b152fb1374ea47f0.text: The story is not only about fighting.

lxc_305a18fcb35da3ca.text: It is also about kindness, family, and friends who stay together when the night is long.

lxc_1322801de6dfb8d6.text: That is why so many readers and viewers care about Tanjiro, Nezuko, Zenitsu, and Inosuke.
